correctness.rationale: Specified partial decoder maps send distinct orthonormal input basis elements to distinct outputs and therefore extend to permutation unitaries in dimension Md, including d<M because (M-1)d>=M-d. The displayed unit range vectors have r=min(M,d) identical summands and all other summands orthogonal, so inner product r/M. The external overlap upper bound ||PQ||<=min(1,d/M), stated explicitly in Wilde abstract, closes equality. Does not assert channel/capacity exponent optimality.
residual_risks: Equality of overlap bound does not prove sharpness of entire strong converse exponent.
